exact: class switch recombination to IgE isotypes
isotype switch recombination to IgE isotypes

definition: The switching of activated B cells from IgM biosynthesis to IgE biosynthesis, accomplished through a recombination process involving an intrachromosomal deletion between switch regions that reside 5' of the IgM and IgE constant region gene segments in the immunoglobulin heavy chain locus.
label: isotype switching to IgE isotypes
